card.name: Resolution after 'until' in withhold instructions
card.fires_on: The word right after 'until' in hold-the-drug instructions (resolution, resolve, recovery). It also fires on 'integr' in 'orally disintegrating tablets' and on 'swallow' or 'water' in tablet-taking directions.

modes.label: Until resolution
modes.description: Resolution or recovery word after 'until' in dose-withholding rules for lab or adverse-reaction grades.
modes.example: Withhold both INLYTA and avelumab or pembrolizumab until<< resolution>> to Grades 0–1

modes.label: Orally disintegrating tablets
modes.description: The 'integr' part of 'disintegrating' in the name of a tablet form.
modes.example: Before prescribing amphetamine extended-release orally dis<<integr>>ating tablets, assess each patient’s risk

modes.label: Taking a tablet
modes.description: Words about swallowing a tablet or taking it with or without water.
modes.example: Administer TASCENSO ODT with or without<< water>>.
